text: 1. Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi pañcahi? 2. Āvāsamaccharī hoti, kulamaccharī hoti, lābhamaccharī hoti, vaṇṇamaccharī hoti, dhammamaccharī hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 3. Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi pañcahi? 4. Na āvāsamaccharī hoti, na kulamaccharī hoti, na lābhamaccharī hoti, [page 267] CCXLI. 1-CCXLII. 1 Duccarita-Vagga. 267 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] na vaṇṇamaccharī hoti, na dhammamaccharī hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. Āvāsikavaggo catuvīsatimo. Uddānaṃ: Āvāsiko piyo ca sobhanā bahūpakāro anukampako ca Yathābhataṃ avaṇṇaṃ ca catukkamacchariyena cā ti. CCXLI.
